activity.notes: Paiva Couceiro was not the constitutional head of Portugal as a whole. He led the royalist regime proclaimed in Porto as the Monarchy of the North and presided over its Governing Junta from 19 January to 13 February 1919. ATLAS therefore links him to that short-lived restoration regime rather than to Portugal generically.

sources.citation_text: Portugal's archival portal states that Paiva Couceiro presided over the government of the Monarchy of the North from 19 January to 13 February 1919.
